concepts_note: Concepts are 1 to 3 word phrases from titles and abstracts (a vocabulary chosen from works up to each year), not OpenAlex topic ids. Coverage uses topic ids.

corpus.note: The export ends in 2023. The corpus also holds 840 records dated 2024 to 2026; they are excluded from every file here (no map, gap or coverage file exists for those years, and they are absent, not zero).

headline_metrics.verdict: model beats best baseline (current_weight) on average_precision: interval excludes 0

headline_source: held-out backtest (backtest.json), which scores the backtest model; the production forecast (gaps.json) has no result and its model may differ (see production_forecast)

layout.method: truncated SVD of positive-PMI co-occurrence matrix, per year
layout.note: Positions are a 2D projection (truncated SVD of the positive-PMI co-occurrence matrix) of this year's snapshot only, so points can move between years. Distance is not research similarity.

production_forecast.label: Production forecast, not the held-out test. A model trained after the held-out test was scored: fit on origins [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2017] and Platt-calibrated at [2020], which is the test origin, so its outcomes were used for training. This model was never itself held-out tested, and its probabilities are not shown to be better calibrated than the backtest model's. It ranks pairs that have not yet co-occurred 3+ times at the 2023 snapshot, the last year in this export. Their outcomes (2024 to 2026) are not observed, so nothing in this file was evaluated. The held-out result is in backtest.json and describes the backtest model, not this one.

model.calibration_method: Platt scaling (logistic fit of the decision value) on the full pair universe of the calibration origin
